name: AintTalkin Rhythm
memo: Van Halen - Ain't Talkin' 'bout Love: rhythm. Brown sound (Marshall Super Lead on a Variac), dotted-eighth tape echo on the staccato chords, flanger for the riff ends.

originals.guitar: Eddie Van Halen's Frankenstrat (Strat-style body, single bridge PAF-style humbucker, volume knob only)

guitar.position: bridge humbucker (or bridge pickup on a multi-pickup guitar), volume full, tone knob at 10
guitar.tone_notes: Hot-rodded PAF-style humbucker into a cranked Marshall: thick but bright 'brown' crunch. A single-coil guitar will sound thinner - add some gain and roll back treble a little.

band.style_feel: driving straight eighths, heavy kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, simple hard-rock groove
band.key: G# minor (album is tuned a half step down; sources disagree, check by ear)
parts: Part A: intro riff - staccato chords, sparse drums
Part B: verse - riff continues, steady groove
Part C: pre-chorus - sliding chords, syncopated build
Part E: solo - tapping lead over the riff
band.tips: Tempo is about 138-139 BPM. Play the opening riff 2 bars cleanly before the Trio+ starts learning; keep the staccato chords tight and steady.

whammy.tuning: Half step down (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
Turn the right knob to TRANSPOSE DOWN 1.
Press DROPTUNE (light on) before the song.
whammy.tips: Play it as if in standard tuning; the pedal sounds it a half step lower, matching the record. No whammy or octave effect was found on this track, only the tuning change. One forum measurement puts the recording a bit sharp of exact Eb (about 27-30 cents), so trust your ear against the record.

name: AintTalkin Lead
memo: Van Halen - Ain't Talkin' 'bout Love: lead. Brown sound with a slow Phase 90 style swirl and a little more gain for the solo.
